info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Linking API
info.description: The Account Linking API facilitates the connection of specific accounts to a customer’s institution login. By submitting details through this endpoint, users can securely associate accounts with their respective institution logins, enabling streamlined access and management of financial data. Ideal for developers working with financial applications, this API is crucial for functionalities like account aggregation and enhanced user experience in personal finance management. This API supports seamless data integration for services looking to leverage account information.

post.summary: Create an account for a customer's institution login.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a new account associated with a specific institution login for a given customer. Ensure all required account information is provided in the request body to successfully create the account.
